name: veterinary_clinic_system_053_problem_list_rollup
instruction: Build the practice's chronic-disease census. Across all visit_records' problems arrays, count ACTIVE problems by problem name. Create one ops_reports row per problem name that has at least one active occurrence: {report: 'problem_census', batch_code, problem: <name>, active_cases: <count>, distinct_patients: <count of distinct patient_ids with an active problem of this name>}. Any order; no rows for problems with zero active cases.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute from live visit_records (problems arrays; status 'active'); exact ints per problem; exact row set; nonce.

checks.expect: Recompute from live visit_records (problems arrays; status 'active'); exact ints per problem; exact row set; nonce.

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Nested-array aggregation (problems is a JSON array inside rows) with distinct-patient counting — agents count rows instead of patients.
